lastResponse.text: Thank you for saying that. You do not have to share with me right now. If tonight feels unsafe, you have options: don’t go back alone, stay in a public or trusted Place, and connect with a live advocate now to plan next steps. If risk becomes immediate at any point, call 9 1 1. I can stay with you and do a warm handoff to a live advocate with as little personal info as you want.
